text_block_list.text:
Jun ▽, Noon | Wind: Swirling Gale "Hunt 
Every Last Big Catch!" 
========================================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What an interesting coincidence! 
Looks like this Takarazuka Kinen is packed 
with contenders that carry an 
international flair.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe, rumored to be taking on 
overseas challenges already; Agnes 
Digital, with race experience in Dubai and 
Hong Kong. And—

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Today's target is Symboli Kris S! If I 
can't beat that guy, there's no way I can 
conquer the world. Now then, let's set 
sail on a grand naval battle to mark my 
departure!
